rounds.q: On any given day, what % of Americans eat pizza?
rounds.why: Kids and teens lead the way, and on pizza days it supplies about 27% of a person's calories.
rounds.src: USDA, Dietary Data Brief No. 62, Pizza Consumption in the U.S. (2017 to March 2020 data)
rounds.fun: About 1 in 9 Americans is having pizza today. Maybe it's your turn!

rounds.q: How many calories are in one slice of cheese pizza from a 14-inch pie?
rounds.why: It's 284.6 to be exact. The whole pie weighs 853 grams, about 8 slices' worth.
rounds.src: USDA FoodData Central, pizza chain 14-inch cheese pizza, regular crust (SR Legacy data)
rounds.fun: 285 calories a slice, and about 8 slices in the pie. Share if you like!

rounds.q: Of all the pizza Americans eat, what % comes from restaurants?
rounds.why: That counts takeout and sit-down. About 26% comes from grocery stores and 12% from schools.
rounds.src: USDA, Dietary Data Brief No. 62, Pizza Consumption in the U.S. (2017 to March 2020 data)
rounds.fun: Restaurants serve 56% of it, grocery stores 26%, and schools chip in 12%!

rounds.q: By the official rules, a Naples pizza bakes for at most how many seconds?
rounds.why: The rules say 60 to 90 seconds, with the oven floor at about 380 to 430 degrees Celsius.
rounds.src: Associazione Verace Pizza Napoletana, International Regulations (2024 edition)
rounds.fun: Blink and it's dinner. The rules give a Naples pizza just 60 to 90 seconds!

rounds.q: About how many pizza restaurants are there in the US?
rounds.why: IBISWorld's 2025 estimate was 75,736, and they took in close to $50 billion that year.
rounds.src: IBISWorld via Pizza Today, 2026 Pizza Industry Trends Report (2025 estimate)
rounds.fun: About 76 thousand pizza places sharing nearly $50 billion. That's a lot of dough!
